ValidationRule.description: Senior+ grades need at least 2 skills and Integration or Security; Directors need Data; Interns cannot carry Security.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Senior', 1, 'Staff', 1, 'Principal', 1, 'Director', 1, 0) = 1, OR(PICKLISTCOUNT(Skills__c) < 2, NOT(OR(INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Integration'), INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Security'))))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Grade__c, 'Director'), NOT(INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Data'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Intern'), INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Security')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Skills do not satisfy grade requirements.
